Apparently, Ambani BHAKTI is all over the public. People are happy with Ambani owning India's communication infrastructure, which should have been owned by PSUs like BSNL and MTNL, but these companies have been deliberately destroyed over the past 30 years so that jobs and ownership in strategic assets can be snatched away from Bahujans, and the entire Hindutva Project can be funded and deployed.

The LOGIC is simply that an Indian Thief (Ambani) is better than an American Thief (Elon Musk). 

I believe Starlink can be a good thing to keep Indian Oligarchs in check and balances.

For those who think, what about National Security? Sir, it's already compromised and at the mercy of the US. BIG TECH Colonialism by the US is everywhere. Majority of apps DATA directly or indirectly is stored on AWS or Google Cloud, Android is owned by the US, and chips and phones are manufactured in China, Taiwan, etc.

Having INFORMATION to ACT and having INCENTIVE to ACT are two different things.

US doesn't want India to become weak beyond a certain level in order to counter CHINA, as GEOPOLITICS is a lot more about GEO-graphy.

comment: The bigger challenge is not just ownership of infrastructure, but building resilient governance around it. Competition helps only when regulation, transparency, and domestic capability grow alongside private investment.
